collectionScope: The Librarians: The Next Chapter Season 2, mapped into the continuing SceneSense Librarians chronology as Season 6.
description: Vikram's team faces a new run of magical outbreaks involving Merlin, wishes, Neverland and haunted artifacts, as old Librarians re-enter the story and the conflict increasingly reaches across time itself.

s06e01.description: An outbreak of irrational rage at an international boarding school brings the Librarians into contact with a man claiming to be Merlin and a magical influence amplifying everyone's anger.

s06e02.description: A freed genie grants uncontrolled wishes across Belgrade, and Vikram's impulsive request magically links him to Jacob Stone while the team searches for a way to restore the genie to confinement.

s06e03.description: Bankers vanish across London as a sinister Peter Pan gathers new Lost Boys, forcing the Librarians into a warped Neverland when Charlie becomes one of his captives.

s06e04.description: Connor falls under a scent-based enchantment and enters a cooking competition, leaving the rest of the team to break the spell by confronting the magical hosts behind the show.

s06e05.description: Lysa's charming new scientist boyfriend appears to be the superhero Red Rock, and the Librarians investigate whether his powers and the crime wave around him come from the same abused artifact.

s06e06.description: While hunting the bracelets of Castor and Pollux, the Librarians begin swapping bodies and discover that Merlin has secretly used the confusion to take control of one of them.

s06e07.description: A hunt for the Monkey's Paw traps the team inside a fogbound hotel where each Librarian must confront old trauma and distinguish a tempting wish from what they actually need.

s06e08.description: A mission to inspect a magical ley line at an old resort turns into a fight against a sentient puppet determined to destroy the property and everyone caught within it.

s06e09.description: Left behind during a Library retreat, Charlie receives calls on a toy phone from a child trapped in a haunted house and recruits Jacob Stone and Cassandra Cillian to help reach the caller.

s06e10.description: Vikram's long-lost love Anya communicates through letters across time, forcing the Librarians to solve a Victorian-era mystery before its magical consequences reshape their present.

s06e11.description: A distress signal leads the team to a town whose entire population has fallen asleep, where the artifact behind the enchantment forces each Librarian to face nightmares made physically real.

s06e12.description: Merlin returns to Camelot with a plan to rewrite history and the future together, forcing the Librarians into a final attempt to preserve the timeline before it collapses.
